Output exactly SIX full-body frames, laid out in a strict equal 3-column by 2-row grid in reading order on a fully transparent canvas, preferably 1536x1024 pixels (each cell 512 square). Use ONLY the FOURTH ordinary creature on TOP ROW of reference: STONEBACK BOAR, stout gray-violet furry boar, layered violet stone back plates, pink broad snout, two large outward ivory tusks, FOUR distinct stocky legs. No other creature. Natural slow quadruped walk with opposite diagonal pairs: frame1 front-left grounded forward, front-right behind; frame2 hind-right pushes while front-right lifts; frame3 front-right swings through, opposite rear leg follows; frame4 front-right lands forward while front-left goes behind; frame5 opposite diagonal pushes; frame6 front-left swings toward frame1. Six visibly different correct leg positions, subtle shoulder/hip roll and snout bob, no hopping as one rigid blob. Camera stays front view with mild overhead angle so face and back plates are visible, no side view or changed facing. Body fills about 70% cell height and 82% width, feet resting on the same 90% floor plane in every cell. Never add ground shadows.
